cohort: 140 pregnant women aged 46-48 years who attended a hospital between September 2018 and December 2019.
finding: Placenta previa was more common in pregnant women of very advanced maternal age (19.5% in the Cesarean section group) compared to pregnancies of normal reproductive age.
birth_weight: Infant birth weight was significantly lower in the Cesarean section group compared to the normal vaginal delivery group.
